detail: Imperial Household Agency map and factual descriptions identify the keep base, three guardhouses, Fujimi buildings and three standing gates.
Imperial Household Agency describes the Fujimi-yagura as three timber stories, 16 m tall above 15 m high stonework, and Fujimi Tamon as a 6.3 m single-storey building above 19 m high masonry.
Chiyoda Ward Tourism gives the standing stone platform dimensions: about 41 by 45 m and about 11 m tall.
The Imperial Household Agency’s East Gardens exhibition documents roughly 10 m standing above the current fill, where later fill conceals some original masonry.
